queries.funding: SELECT funding_time,symbol,funding_rate FROM funding_rates_binance WHERE symbol=ANY(:symbols) AND funding_time>=:start AND funding_time<:end ORDER BY funding_time,symbol
queries.bars: SELECT date_bin('8 hours',ts,TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00') AS block_start,sum(power(ln(close/open),2)) AS minute_squared_return,count(*) AS source_rows,count(DISTINCT ts) AS distinct_rows,min(ts) AS first_ts,max(ts) AS last_ts,bool_and(open>0 AND high>0 AND low>0 AND close>0 AND high>=greatest(open,close,low) AND low<=least(open,close,high)) AS coherent FROM bars_binance WHERE symbol='BTCUSDT' AND interval='1m' AND ts>=:start AND ts<:end GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
